changes.title: Tobacco and vape tax bill
changes.what_happened: A favorable report prepares the bill for its final Senate debate (PL 243 Senado).
changes.why_it_matters: It proposes a COP 5,100 tax per pack of 20, with annual increases above inflation.
changes.who_is_affected: Smokers, producers, and health and sports budgets.
